dedupe_keys.name: rfid exsim passive rfid reader event benchmarks

description: RFID-ExSim contains more than four hundred thousand timestamped events from two synchronised RFID readers and twelve passive tags in a controlled Casablanca laboratory. The producer compares normal operation, reader collisions, tag-identity ambiguity, replay or injection, and high-rate stress scenarios. Metadata describe millisecond timestamps, reader and tag identifiers, hashed UIDs, distance and orientation, with JSON Lines and consolidated CSV representations. Zenodo publishes the archive under MIT with free access, and the linked repository documents the event schema and acquisition scenarios. Coverage is short-range bench experiments, with distances of one to four centimetres and exact collection dates unestablished. Limited hardware and induced conditions constrain field inference. A reviewer-assessed use is checking collision and identification-failure assumptions in logistics tracking or access-control simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related communications simulator, without verified RFID integration. No tag data, firmware, shared reviewer link or attack procedure was downloaded or executed.
